vintage: Holders serving in October 2026 (territory legislatures as their pages give them; a vacant legislative seat: the member whose leaving vacated it in 2025 or 2026)
table: The party of each holder the game's rosters leave unrecorded (src/core2/modules/officials.ts unrecordedParty), by seat
title: Parties of unrecorded officeholders: territory governors and legislatures, offices elected without party labels, and vacant state legislative seats
universe: Seats whose holder's party the game's rosters (data/research/offices/legislature-party-counts-2026.json, data/research/offices/statewide-executive-parties-2026.json, the NGA governor list in data/source/electoral-calibration-2024/corpus.json) do not record
geography: All 56 places, keyed by postal-code jurisdiction; a place with no unrecorded holder has an empty seats table
limits: Holders are those serving when the pages were read (October 2026), as the game's other rosters are, not on the game's start date. A territory legislature is seated at large until its districts are read (SG-GOV-territory-legislature-districts), so its party counts are assigned to its seats in the order listed. appliesTo 'office' means the office's ballot carries no party, so any holder sits without one; 'opening' means the party of the holder at the opening only. Seats in unreadSeats are left to the estimate: six vacancies with no row in Ballotpedia's 2025 or 2026 vacancy tables, and seats the game creates when a Census district name does not match the roster's name (gov-offices-roster-district-name-mismatch); the Virgin Islands boards of education and of elections were not read.
